_comment: The v5 score (D41): a bar-line edit of the SAME Eleven Music take as v4 (music_v2_5, seed 7101, 152 s, 120.004 BPM, beats at 0.0065 + k/2 s), no new generation. Film clock = grid clock: film frame 0 = grid 0 (the score starts on the film's first frame); 105.0 s = 3150 f. The take's 8-bar phrases run from its lift at source 32 (32, 48, 64, ... 144), each ending on a fill bar (62-64 is a kick drop-out, 94-96 a hats fill). Night (+4 dB, so it is heard under the voice): the last 15.5 s of the take's Night (source 16-31.5: its 2 loud / 2 quiet bars and the rise), cut dead one beat before daySlip, so S05 is followed by 0.5 s of silence and the take's own lift (source 32) lands on daySlip. One 16-bar splice at film 46 (source 62 -> 94) skips the drop-out bar and two phrases, so the take's final hit (source 144) lands on endHit (film 96); it sits 0.4 s after the flag hit, under its tail. The 19 s roll (from the beat after S10 to the word 'Possibly') strips to bass and ticks, then the band returns with a sub hit on the sixteenth that meets 'Possibly'. FIX is low-passed and opens over the 2 beats before S18 (on a bar line), full band and a small sub hit there (snapBack). JIRA's last 2 bars build (riser, then a 1-bar high-pass) into endHit, where a sub hit doubles the take's hit; its C major ring-out is time-stretched 2.5x so it rings under S21 and S22 to the film's last frame.

segments.why: Night: source bars 8-15 of the take's Night (16-31.5), its rise over the last 3 bars, cut one beat early
the hard stop: one beat of silence before daySlip (S05 ends at 15.42)
the take's lift on daySlip (source 32), its first phrase and 7 bars of the second (the drop-out bar 62-64 is skipped)
from the hats-fill bar that ends the take's 4th phrase (94-96), its phrases 5-7, the final hit at film 96 = source 144 and its first quarter second
the ring-out (a C major chord) 2.5x slower, so it lasts to the film's end (source 144.25-147.75)

sweeps.why: the 19 s roll: bass and ticks only from the beat after S10, released on the sixteenth of 'Possibly'
FIX: a person fixes the page under a muffled groove (900 Hz), opening over the 2 beats before S18
the last bar before endHit thins upward; full band on the hit

gain.why: the Night bed +4 dB: at the take's level it sat about 21 dB under the voice (Day scenes about 15 dB); now about 17 dB, still under the Day
the ring-out fades to silence on the film's last frame

synth.why: a 2-bar riser into endHit, at its top on the hit

subHits.why: flag: the page flips to Possibly stale (the sixteenth nearest the word, f1368.75; the word at f1368.6)
snapBack: S18 on its bar line, 'Verified' 2 f later; the low-pass is fully open
endHit: the end card lands; doubles the take's own final hit

cues.what: Night: sub pulse on the beat, ticking hats, dark pad; mid band 2 loud / 2 quiet bars, rising over the last 3 bars
hard stop: one beat of silence before daySlip
the Day lift on daySlip (kick, backbeat, bright synths), then a steady drive
the 19 s roll: the band strips to bass and ticks
flag: full band back on 'Possibly' with a sub hit; a hats-fill bar, then a new 8-bar phrase at 48 (S12 at 48.5); steady drive under AGENTS
FIX: low-pass 900 Hz (2-beat sweep down), opening over the 2 beats before S18
snapBack: full band and a small sub hit on S18's bar line; steady drive under JIRA
build: a 2-bar riser, a 1-bar high-pass into endHit
endHit: the take's final hit plus a sub hit; its C major ring-out (2.5x stretched) under S21 and S22, fading to silence on the last frame

expect._why: timeline-v5.mjs checks these against src/data/timeline.json (seconds from frame 0); a mismatch marks the score pending
